text:
deploy-bot: Deploy check failed for release v2026.03.10 (job 3245) — env-parity: secret scope mismatch detected. Blocking promotion to prod.

ash: wait, what's the exact mismatch?

deploy-bot: staging pods reference secret `staging/inference-api` (namespaced). prod manifests reference `inference-api-cluster` (cluster-scoped). policy:prod requires namespaced secret.

mike: oof. Which services will break if we force the prod manifest? model-router + emb-proxy + inference-gateway.

lenna: can we create a namespaced secret in prod from the cluster secret as a short-term shim?

ash: theoretically yes but security might block reading the cluster secret due to KMS wrap. Also we need audit approval.

security: tagging in — we can't copy cluster secrets into namespaces without a BSL approval for this release window.

mike: options: 1) hotpatch deployments to use the cluster secret name (quick code change), 2) back out release and pin to previous stable tag, 3) create a namespaced mirror secret via approved runbook (slower). Thoughts?

ash: hotpatch risky — code paths expect namespaced mount path. Backout/pin seems lowest-risk if we need to keep the change window clean.

lenna: what's the rollout impact? We have customer-facing infra changes in this release, delay will push to next change window (tomorrow 02:00 UTC).

mike: can we do a minimal config-only hotfix that normalizes the secretRef to try both? i.e. add an env var fallback so process reads CLUSTER_SECRET || NAMESPACE_SECRET. If cluster secret present we use it.

ash: that requires a tiny image bump and redeploy — still a release though. Not great.

sre-oncall: quick triage — is the prod cluster secret value current? If yes and we can get temporary KMS unwrap to create namespaced secret, we could do a controlled shim with audit record and revert after proper fix.

security: we can accelerate an emergency approval but need: justification, change window, and who will own the postmortem. Also need to update release notes for exact secret scope.

lenna: propose: hold promotion for now. Create an emergency change request to copy cluster secret into `prod/inference-api` with restricted RBAC, owner = mike, window = in 45m, fallback = rollback to tag v2026.02.98 if anything fails. Postmortem + release notes update assigned to ash.

mike: I can own the change. I'll start the CR and ping infra to request KMS unwrap.

ash: sounds good. Deploybot — keep this release blocked until we confirm the change was applied and smoke tests pass.

deploy-bot: Release promotion paused and annotated: reason="secret scope mismatch (cluster vs namespaced)". Will re-evaluate after `prod/inference-api` exists and smoke-tests:inference-gateway succeed.

lenna: quick checklist for the CR: 1) proof of value (smoke pass steps) 2) audit log export 3) rollback procedure 4) update runbook to require namespaced secret for service manifests.

mike: creating CR + PR with the mirror job now. I'll update this thread with CR link.

ash: thanks — also add a line in the release notes: "Postponed: customer-facing routing changes due to env-parity secret scope discrepancy. Will reschedule once parity is restored."

security: +1 on audit + postmortem. We'll need to know if this is systemic (CI produces different secret refs) or one-off.

lenna: filing postmortem ticket and tagging CI infra. We'll also run a short scan across all helm charts to detect any secretRef that points to cluster-scoped names.

mike: CR created: https://cr.internal/r/6789 — awaiting KMS unwrap request.

ash: ok holding release. Thanks everyone. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lenna: assigning followups: mike (apply shim), ash (release notes + postmortem), lenna (helm scan + CI alert rule).

sre-oncall: I'll monitor the change window and smoke tests. Ping me when CR is approved.

mike: will do. updating status here when done. :thumbsup:
